section_summary: This section contains State Department, Army Department, and foreign diplomatic records from May to July 1948 concerning travel and entry permits for commercial entrants, repatriates, and foreign nationals visiting occupied Japan and Okinawa. It documents individual business travel applications, procedures for nationals of countries whose interests in Japan were handled by protecting powers (such as Pakistan represented by the United Kingdom and Brazil by Portugal), and the Chilean repatriation of Hiroshi Yamada Yashiro. In addition, it covers diplomatic and intelligence investigations into an aborted Japanese passenger cruise from Brazil organized by Brasiltur, as well as official distribution of SCAP's comprehensive 'Guide for Commercial Entrants to Japan'.
